verdict.rationale: Jules documents creating API keys in the web app Settings page, capped at 3 at a time. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped, permission-limited or restricted to least privilege. Plain unscoped API keys are an adjacent capability, not scoped credentials for an agent, so the axis applies but is not delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: In the Jules web app, go to the Settings page to create a new API key. You can have at most 3 API keys at a time.
